name: Read AI Palace Great Work deal eligibility and recipient capacity without transfer

condition.code: return Game and Game.GetCurrentGameTurn and Game.GetCurrentGameTurn()>=0

steps.code:
local A=assert(JAC_AbsorptionGameplay)
local index=0
local tag='creator-owned'
local before=A.NativeWorkLocations(index)
assert(#before==1 and before[1].Owner==2 and before[1].BuildingType=='BUILDING_PALACE',
  'AI Palace original not present at this checkpoint: '..tag)
local work=before[1]
local empty=0
local first=''
for _,city in Players[1]:GetCities():Members() do
  local buildings=city:GetBuildings()
  for building in GameInfo.Buildings() do
    if buildings:HasBuilding(building.Index) then
      for slot=0,buildings:GetNumGreatWorkSlots(building.Index)-1 do
        if buildings:GetGreatWorkInSlot(building.Index,slot)==-1 then
          local slotID=buildings:GetGreatWorkSlotType(building.Index,slot)
          local slotInfo=GameInfo.GreatWorkSlotTypes[slotID]
          if slotInfo then
            for match in GameInfo.GreatWork_ValidSubTypes() do
              if match.GreatWorkObjectType==work.ObjectType
                and match.GreatWorkSlotType==slotInfo.GreatWorkSlotType then
                empty=empty+1
                if first=='' then first=city:GetX()..','..city:GetY()..':'..building.BuildingType..':'..slot end
                break
              end
            end
          end
        end
      end
    end
  end
end
local possible='unavailable'
if DealManager and DealDirection and DealItemTypes
  and DealManager.GetWorkingDeal and DealManager.GetPossibleDealItems then
  local ok,working=pcall(DealManager.GetWorkingDeal,DealDirection.OUTGOING,2,1)
  if ok and working then
    local read,items=pcall(DealManager.GetPossibleDealItems,2,1,DealItemTypes.GREATWORK,working)
    if read then
      possible='missing'
      for _,item in ipairs(items or {}) do
        if item.ForType==index then possible=tostring(item.IsValid);break end
      end
    else possible='read-error' end
  else possible='working-unavailable' end
end
local after=A.NativeWorkLocations(index)
assert(#after==1 and after[1].Owner==work.Owner and after[1].CityID==work.CityID
  and after[1].Building==work.Building and after[1].Slot==work.Slot,
  'read-only Palace probe changed the original')
print('[JAC_AI_PALACE_READ] tag='..tag..' index='..index
  ..' creator='..tostring(work.CreatedByPlayer)..' owner='..work.Owner
  ..' emptyCompatible='..empty..' first='..first..' dealItemValid='..possible)
return 'AI Palace read-only source and recipient capacity recorded: '..tag
